apps.versionDescription: v1.5.18 — Session scoping fix: Varisai no longer shows Stop or highlights swaras while a phrase plays in Compose or LoopLab (and the Raga scale and piano no longer light up for other studios either). Each studio now reads only its own session from the shared player.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
